liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightning** (3 reviews): Lazy Lightning transitioning into Supplication was the highlight of the first set; The reviewer loves the Lazy Lightning and Supplication transition in the first set [5][8][9]
- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): The transition from Playing in the Band into Franklin's Tower is killer; The invocation of light from Playing into Franklin's Tower was described as thundery [4][11]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Friend Of The Devil and The Music Never Stopped are quality first-set performances [4]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Eyes of the World is described as a magical version in this recording [14]
- **China Doll** (1 review): China Doll is highlighted as a sweet performance in the second set [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97183.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 25 songs; 185 min; rated 4.73/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Talkers are audible during the first set of the audience recording; The energy level is described as through the roof in this recording; This recording is clearer than the Bertrando source but requires higher volume [3][6][7][14]
- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97140.flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 185 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- A female concertgoer joked about smelling cigarettes stronger than dope before Candyman [8]
- A female concertgoer joked about smelling cigarettes stronger than dope before Candyman [9]
- This MOTB transfer is considered superior to another outstanding audience source [3]
- The show is often forgotten because it previously circulated only as an audience recording [5]
- The reviewer prefers the first set of the Bertrando recording to this one [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97183.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG 224E => Sony TC-158SD >> MAC [1]. Also: Bob was patched out of Rob Bertrando for this specific recording; The 18th Row FOB tape was paused between most first-set songs; A tape flip occurs at the end of Eyes of the World into Drums [1]
- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97140.flac24**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG 224E => Sony TC-15XSD >> MAC [2]
